crawler.name: Crawler
crawler.hint: Hunts you down two hexes at a time, and strikes as soon as it is next to you.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.hint: Holds its post and hits hard up close. Hit it from range twice and it comes after you.

ghost_process.name: Ghost Process
ghost_process.hint: Drifts at random, and fires when you are within 2 hexes and in its line of sight. Walls block its shots.
